nodes.rationale: HTML source rendered to the docs' Open Graph social card: dark #0b0a12 background with purple and cyan radial glows and a faint grid, eyebrow 'Documentation', gradient-accented headline 'The control plane for your microfrontends', subtitle 'Versions, environments, deployments and rollbacks — plus the Module Federation config your host needs', embedded base64 logo mark and the mfe-orchestrator.dev URL — positioning the product as a microfrontend control plane.
